_comment: YouTube IDs for the video catalogue. This is the ONE place they live — docs/videos.md, site/src/content/docs/videos.mdx and the README all point at these cuts, and a moved link is fixed here first. `youtube` is the 11-character video ID, never the full URL; an empty string renders the poster without a link instead of a dead one. `short` marks a 9:16 cut, which embeds portrait and lives under /shorts/ on YouTube's own site.
